response.Authorization: Persist only from successful signIn or confirmUser

jwt.storage: Platform secure storage; never log the token

statusHandling.204: Success with empty body — do not JSON-parse
statusHandling.401: Clear local session and show sign-in UI (except register-waiting screen)
statusHandling.422: Show error.message; bind error.details to fields

timeoutAndOffline.noResponse: Do not mutate local auth state; let the user retry
timeoutAndOffline.offline: Do not queue Auth writes; show offline; retry on user action when online
timeoutAndOffline.autoRetry: Do not blindly auto-retry registerUser, signIn, password, or confirmation writes

registerSessionRule: Ignore any Authorization on registerUser. Session starts only after confirmUser or signIn.

deviceToken.afterJwt: registerDeviceToken after signIn or confirmUser / FCM refresh
deviceToken.onSignOut: unregisterDeviceToken before signOut while JWT is still valid

avatar: Profile photo upload/clear contract lives in docs/mobile/users (multipart user[avatar] on updateCurrentUser). registerUser may accept the same multipart field; do not invent a JSON-string avatar.
